title: A New Chess Game
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Ji stepped out of the secret realm, the sky tore apart, and a colossal eye spanning ten thousand li slowly opened from the depths of the Void— the Heaven's Eye's true form had descended, its oppressive might toppling like mountain peaks, and billions of thunderbolts gestated within its pupil.

text.content: The seventh layer of the secret realm, the deepest part of the Tianji Hall. Chen Ji stood on a floating altar, the Tianji Record hovering before him, golden light enveloping his entire body. A countdown flickered in his vision—thirty days until Chen Nian's sacrifice. His fingers tightened briefly, then relaxed. A faint smile curled at the corner of his lips, a smile chillingly cold. "Thirty days... that's enough." he murmured, his voice as calm as discussing the weather. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul materialized in the Tianji Record, watching the young man silently—too well did he know Chen Ji, understanding the tumultuous storm brewing beneath that serene exterior.

At the center of the altar, an ancient stone door slowly opened. Behind it was not the expected treasure, but a vast star sea. Within the star sea, countless points of light floated like chess pieces on a board, while in the higher realms, a massive eye could be vaguely seen— that eye watched over all the points of light, as if observing ants on a chessboard. "This is the truth." Mo Xiansheng's voice emerged, carrying a hint of vicissitude, "The Heaven's Eye is not a free will. It is also a chess piece, a puppet of a higher existence." Chen Ji stared at the colossal eye, his heartbeat quickening for the first time. Not fear, but excitement. What was the Heaven's Eye? As long as it was not the true Chess Player, everything could be knocked down into the dust.

dialogue.content: "When the three pages of the Tianji Record unite as one, one can glimpse the true chessboard." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul spoke slowly, "And now, it is time for you to see everything." As his voice fell, the three pages of the Tianji Record simultaneously blazed with dazzling light—golden, cyan, and blood-colored lights interweaving, weaving a shocking scene before Chen Ji's eyes: countless worlds floated in the Void like bubbles, each world watched over by an eye. And those very eyes were bound by countless chains, connected to the darkness above.

text.content: Chen Ji felt massive information flooding into his mind. The complete content of the Tianji Record's third page seared into the depths of his divine soul—not prophetic ability, but a map. A map leading to where the Chess Players resided. "So that's how it is." he murmured, his eyes gleaming sharply, "So the Tianji Record itself is a key. The reason prophets were selected throughout history was not because they had talent, but because they had the qualification to become keys." He suddenly laughed, his laughter echoing in the empty altar, "Interesting. It seems this 'waste' had his script arranged from birth."

dialogue.content: Just then, a demonic aura pierced through the air, and Ye Qing's figure stepped out from the Void. Her face was pale, clearly having spent massive元气 crossing the realm's barrier. "Chen Ji, I sensed—" Her words came to an abrupt halt. The scene of that massive eye in the star sea reflected into her eyes, her pupils contracting sharply, "That is... the Heaven's Eye's true form?" Chen Ji turned to look at her, his gaze calm: "Precisely speaking, it is its prison." Ye Qing froze for a moment, then understood. She was the Holy Sect Saint, and she had deep pain regarding being trapped in a higher chess game—she herself was nothing more than a chess piece used by the Holy Sect!

text.content: Chen Ji took out a blood-colored token from the Tianji Record and lightly tossed it to Ye Qing. "This is a core access token within the Holy Sect." His voice was indifferent, "The scene I saw using the Tianji Record, you should still remember. What the Holy Sect Grand Elder said personally—'Her value exists only at the moment of sacrifice.'" Ye Qing took the token, her knuckles whitening from force. She looked at Chen Ji, seeing sincerity in this "waste's" eyes for the first time: "What do you want me to do?" Chen Ji stared directly into her eyes: "You and I, join hands, to overturn this chess game. Regarding the Holy Sect, I will clean house for you. You owe me one favor."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing was silent for a moment, then suddenly laughed lightly. That laughter carried both relief and determination. "Chen Ji, you are the craziest person I have ever met." She put away the token, her features becoming sharper, "Daring to challenge the Heaven's Eye, daring to move the Holy Sect. Fine, I agree with you." She extended her hand, and demonic energy condensed into a pitch-black mark in her palm, "This is the pact mark of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path. From today onward, the forces of the Demonic Path shall be at your disposal." Chen Ji did not immediately take it, but looked at her: "Aren't you afraid I will use you?" Ye Qing met his gaze: "I am. But compared to continuing to be a chess piece, I'd rather take the gamble."

text.content: The moment Chen Ji accepted the pact mark, the Tianji Record vibrated again. A new page slowly emerged—not prophecy, but a scene: on the altar thirty days later, Chen Nian was bound at the center of the sacrificial platform, the Heaven's Eye's projection笼罩着她. However, in the scene there was another figure—Chen Ji himself, drenched in blood, yet standing before Chen Nian, facing the entire heavens. "This is your destiny's turning point." Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out, "At that moment, you will completely break with the Heaven's Eye, with no way back." Chen Ji looked at his blood-soaked self, a cold smile curling at the corner of his lips: "No way back?" he murmured, "From the moment I transmigrated into this body, I never intended to look back."

The altar began to collapse, and the spatial structure of the secret realm underwent dramatic changes the moment Chen Ji obtained the third page. Countless precious resources gushed out from the collapsing stone walls—heavenly-grade spirit stones, ancient cultivation technique fragments, rare spiritual medicines... "Take them all." Chen Ji waved his sleeve, and all resources were stored in the spatial dimension opened by the Tianji Record. This was wealth sufficient to shake the entire cultivation world, now entirely under his control. Meanwhile, outside the secret realm at Tianqing Sect, all elders simultaneously sensed the abnormal changes. Dark clouds gathered thickly above the horizon, thunder and lightning brewing within the clouds—this was a celestial phenomenon, foreshadowing a groundbreaking opportunity's birth. Lin Xiao stood in the Sect Master's great hall, his murky old eyes flashing with sharp light: "Found it?"

Chen Ji brought Ye Qing, passing through the collapsing spatial node, appearing at the secret realm's exit. The blinding sunlight made him squint slightly. The scene outside the secret realm made his eyes narrow slightly—Xuanwu Sect, Holy Sect, and the rogue cultivator alliance, three major forces had surrounded the exit tightly. Han Lie stood at the very front of the Xuanwu Sect's group, holding a black iron heavy sword, murderous intent surging. "Chen Ji!" Han Lie recognized him at a glance, laughing ragefully, "You stray dog, finally willing to come out?" He raised his heavy sword, pointing it at Chen Ji, "Hand over everything you obtained from the secret realm, and I'll spare your life!" The cultivators from the three sects around laughed loudly, all thinking this waste had tremendous audacity, daring to face such an array alone.

Just then, the Tianji Record trembled once more. A line of golden text appeared before Chen Ji's eyes:

「The Eye of Heavenly Secrets has sensed your challenge. Before the countdown ends, it will conduct a probing attempt.」

Chen Ji stared at these words, a playful curve forming at the corner of his mouth: 'A probe? Good. Let them come.'

text.content: After the three sect forces withdrew, Chen Ji and Ye Qing arrived at a secluded valley.\n\n'Are you truly going to do this?' Ye Qing looked at Chen Ji, her expression complex, 'Publicly declaring war on the Eye of Heavenly Secrets is equivalent to pushing yourself to the forefront of the storm.' Chen Ji leaned against a massive rock, gazing up at the sky: 'Ye Qing, what do you think my previous choice was?' Ye Qing frowned: '暗中布局，步步为营。' Chen Ji nodded: 'Exactly. But circumstances have changed now.' He sat upright, sharp light blazing in his eyes, 'Chen Nian only has thirty days left. There's no time for behind-the-scenes scheming. I must gather all forces at the fastest speed, and before that moment arrives, possess the capital to directly confront the Eye of Heavenly Secrets.'

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul emerged from his embrace, the old man's voice sounding: 'Boy, do you understand what this means? Once the Eye of Heavenly Secrets truly gazes upon you, all your schemes will be laid bare.' Chen Ji stood up, brushing dust from his robes: 'I know. But Mo Xiansheng, you've forgotten one thing.' He looked at the old man's remnant soul, 'The fragments of the Tianji Record are continuously improving. When I gather all the pages, so-called gazes are nothing more than a chess piece on my board.' Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, then suddenly burst into laughter: 'Good! Good! Good! This old man has waited five hundred years for this day!'

text.content:
Over the next three days, Chen Ji began frantic resource integration.

The ancient cultivation technique fragments obtained from the secret realm allowed him to complete the final few realms of the 「Tianji Art」, his Combat Power surging directly from Foundation Building early stage to Nascent Soul peak.

Heaven-grade spirit stones were used to arrange the 「Celestial Cycles Star Formation」, a terrifying great formation capable of borrowing star power—once activated, it could contend against cultivators at the Transformation God stage.

Rare spiritual medicines were refined into 「Heavenly Fate Pills」, capable of temporarily compensating for Heavenly Fate consumption—though limited in quantity, at critical moments, these were the trump cards for turning the tide.

'These elixirs, leave half for Chen Nian.' Chen Ji stored the elixirs into the Tianji Record, 'If she retains consciousness during the sacrifice, these can help her survive the most dangerous moment.' Ye Qing watched his back, for the first time sensing the softest part within this 'waste's' heart.

On the third night, the Tianji Record brought new prophecy.

In the vision, Chen Ji stood before the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate, facing Ling Yuan's interrogation. And behind him, Su Qingyao held a longsword, her expression complex.

'Ling Yuan has already begun suspecting you.' After Ye Qing finished viewing the prophecy, she said, 'And Su Qingyao seems to have noticed something as well.' Chen Ji nodded, his fingers gently tapping the Tianji Record's cover: 'Regarding Ling Yuan, I have arrangements. As for Su Qingyao...' He paused, a complex light flickering in his eyes, 'Leave her alone for now. She is the only one who has approached the truth without tearing down the paper window. Such a person is either an enemy or an ally. There is no third path.'

text.content: Chen Ji found Su Qingyao, the latter standing at the peak of Tianqing Peak, gazing at the distant sea of clouds. 'Su-shimei.' Chen Ji's voice came from behind. Su Qingyao did not turn around, her voice cold: 'Chen-shidi, your aura has changed. Foundation Building to Nascent Soul, three days—you showed me what a true genius truly is.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji did not defend himself, simply walking to her side and standing shoulder to shoulder. 'Su-shimei, I've always been curious—why didn't you expose me when you clearly sensed something?' Su Qingyao finally turned her head, her cool eyes carrying a hint of scrutiny: 'Because you once saved my life.' Chen Ji愣了一下，随即想起来—三个月前的那次秘境探索，他用天机录提前预知了她的危机，暗中出手相助。\n\n'So, I want to give you a chance.' Su Qingyao looked at him, 'Tell me, who exactly are you?'

Su Qingyao watched his retreating figure, a flash of confusion flickering in her eyes. This person was becoming increasingly incomprehensible to her. "Chen Ji..." she murmured, "just what kind of scheme are you weaving?"

Just as Chen Ji left Tianqing Peak, the Tianji Record emitted a faint vibration. His footsteps paused, a curve forming at the corner of his lips.

Tianji Record indicated: All three of Su Qingyao's investigations had been preemptively resolved. System prompt: [Red Beauty Guardian] progress maintained unchanged.

"Good." Chen Ji murmured softly, "Continue maintaining this distance. When the moment ripens, I will make her stand on my side willingly."

text.content:
Chen Ji secretly orchestrated an assassination attempt targeting Su Qingyao. The assassin was a death warrior from the Holy Sect, and Chen Ji appeared at a critical moment to rescue her. "You're safe now." He supported the injured Su Qingyao, his voice tender. Su Qingyao leaned against his chest, gazing up at him, eyes full of relief from surviving the ordeal. "Why... is it always you?" Her voice trembled slightly.

Chen Ji patted her back gently, though a subtle cold smile flickered across his lips. The trap had already been set; now, he simply needed to close the net.

At dawn on the fourth day, Chen Ji stood atop the highest peak of Tianqing Sect, overlooking the entire sect.

Behind him, Ye Qing stood silently, demonic energy swirling around her. "All preparations are complete." she reported, "Regarding the Demonic Path, I've convinced three elders to support us. The opposing forces within the Holy Sect are also moving covertly. With just your command, the great war can begin at any time." Chen Ji nodded, his gaze fixed on the distant horizon. There, the clouds churned exceptionally, as if something was brewing. "Soon." he murmured, "The Heavenly Eye's test is coming faster than I anticipated."

Just then, the sky suddenly darkened.

Not from dark clouds obscuring the sun, but from something descending from higher realms, blocking the sunlight. Chen Ji looked up to see a massive eye slowly opening in the heavens.

This eye was more immense and real than any vision he had witnessed in the secret realm. Within the pupil were countless rotating stars, and deep within those stars, a vague silhouette was faintly visible—that was the so-called "Heavenly Eye's main body."

Pressure descended like mountain avalanches, with billions of thunderbolts brewing within the eye. The entire Tianqing Sect fell into panic at this moment, countless disciples kneeling on the ground, trembling.

dialogue.content:
An ancient yet commanding voice echoed from the heavens, reverberating throughout the entire cultivation world:

"Chen Ji." The voice exploded directly in his mind, "A creature like an ant dares challenge this seat?" Chen Ji felt a terrifying divine consciousness invading his soul, attempting to read all his memories. The Tianji Record automatically protected its master, radiating golden light, barely resisting this invasion.

"Interesting." The Heavenly Eye's voice carried a hint of amusement, "Turns out you are an inheritor of the Tianji Record. No wonder you dare act so recklessly. But do you think a single broken treasure can compete against heaven?"

text.content:
Chen Ji felt excruciating pain in his soul, but gritting his teeth, he forced himself not to kneel. Blood flowed from his nostrils, yet he remained standing straight.

"Compete against heaven?" he suddenly laughed, that laughter sounding particularly harsh under the celestial pressure, "No, you misunderstand." He raised his head, directly facing that massive eye, "I am not here to compete with you—I am here to replace you." These words struck like thunder, echoing in everyone's ears.

The Heavenly Eye fell silent for a moment, then erupted into sky-shaking laughter: "HAHAHA! Excellent! Excellent! Excellent! In five hundred years, the first person to dare speak such words to this seat!" In the laughter, the pressure suddenly increased tenfold.

choice.prompt: Facing the Heavenly Eye's first probe, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.text: Fight to the end, never show weakness
choices.description: Directly confront the Heavenly Eye's pressure, prove your determination through action. Even if the soul is injured, let the opponent know your spirit.

choices.visible_reward: Establish prestige before the Heavenly Eye, all factions reassess your value

text.content:
Chen Ji fiercely bit his tongue, spewing a mouthful of essence blood onto the Tianji Record. Golden light erupted violently, directly colliding with the Heavenly Eye's pressure. The air seemed to freeze at this moment, terrifying energy fluctuations sweeping across all directions, countless peaks collapsing under this impact.

"You—" The Heavenly Eye uttered for the first time in surprise, "Bold!"

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji was blasted dozens of zhang away, blood spurting from his mouth. Yet he continued laughing, that smile tinged with madness, "Is this all the pressure you can muster? The prophet from five hundred years ago had far more backbone than you!" He struggled to stand, hands forming seals, a brilliant sword qi surging from the Tianji Record, shooting directly toward the massive eye in the heavens.

The Heavenly Eye coldly snorted, a thunderbolt striking down, annihilating that sword qi. But Chen Ji had already vanished from his original position—he had long prepared a contingency, escaping completely unharmed.

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly suppressed his aura, knelt on one knee, and adopted a posture of submission: 'Senior, please calm your anger. I was merely speaking recklessly. I hope you will be magnanimous.' The Heavenly Eye slightly narrowed, as if examining this ant. After a moment, it let out a disdainful snort: 'Turns out you're a spineless wretch. This one thought you actually had some ability.'

The pressure slowly receded, and the sky returned to normal. But Chen Ji knew this was only temporary. The Heavenly Eye had left its mark on his soul, and wherever he fled, he would be tracked.

'Chen Ji.' Ye Qing's voice came from behind, tinged with worry. 'Are you alright?' Chen Ji wiped the blood from his mouth and slowly stood up, a cold gleam flickering in his eyes: 'I'm fine. Everything just now was merely an act performed for its benefit.' He raised his head toward the gradually dispersing heavens. 'One day, I will make this eye close forever.'

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly burst into laughter, the sound tinged with madness: 'The Heavenly Eye? The lofty Heavenly Will?' He stretched out his finger, pointing at the giant eye in the heavens. 'Don't think I don't know! Your true form is nothing more than a chess piece bound by chains on a higher chessboard! Those so-called fate, prophecy, heavenly fate—nothing but the scraps your master deigned to throw you!'

The Heavenly Eye trembled violently—that was anger—no, that was fear. Countless cultivators looked up at the sky and witnessed the fleeting panic flashing through that giant eye.

'Silence!' The Heavenly Eye's voice lost its composure for the first time, becoming sharp and shrill. 'You insignificant ant, how could you possibly know—' Before the words finished, a golden light burst from Chen Ji's body, forcibly dispersing the Heavenly Eye's projection.

'I told you.' Chen Ji's voice echoed between heaven and earth. 'Since we're all chess pieces, then I'll overturn the entire chessboard.'

After the Heavenly Eye's projection dissipated, the entire cultivation world fell into a deathly silence.

The scene just witnessed had overturned everyone's understanding. A servant disciple written off as worthless had actually challenged the Heavenly Eye publicly, and—escaped unharmed.

'Chen Ji...' Ling Yuan stood in the sect master's great hall, his aged eyes flickering with complex emotions. This young man he once disdainfully ignored had grown to a level he could no longer overlook. 'The successor of the Tianji Record...' he murmured. 'So that's how it is.' He turned toward the void. 'Initiate the backup plan. Since he chose to step into the spotlight, let's show him what true sect heritage truly means.'

dialogue.content:
Meanwhile, in another corner of the Tianqing Sect, Su Qingyao stood transfixed, gazing at the direction where Chen Ji had departed.

In her mind, the previous scene kept replaying. That cowardly, worthless junior brother had stood tall under the Heavenly Eye's overwhelming pressure and declared, 'I will replace you.'

'So... from the very beginning, I had him completely wrong.' she murmured, her eyes filled with complex emotions. At that moment, a door that had always been tightly shut in her heart cracked open.

text.content:
Chen Ji returned to his quarters, where Ye Qing was already waiting.

'That scene just now will spread throughout the cultivation world.' she said. 'From today onward, you will no longer be that obscure waste. You'll become a target—some will want to recruit you, some will attempt to use you, and others will want to kill you.' Chen Ji nodded, walking to the window to watch the sky gradually brightening: 'I know.' He paused. 'But I had no choice. Chen Nian only has twenty-six days left. Secret plotting is too slow. I must step into the spotlight, making all forces see me—then force them to make their choices.'

dialogue.content:
Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul materialized from Chen Ji's embrace, gazing at the young man's back with eyes full of heartfelt approval.

'Young man, you did well.' His voice carried a sense of nostalgia. 'Five hundred years ago, I too faced the same choice. Unfortunately, I chose to endure in silence, ultimately missing the chance to save her.' He paused. 'You're stronger than me. Because you dare to unsheathe your blade.' Chen Ji turned to look at this elderly guardian who had watched over him for so long: 'Mo Xiansheng, the 'her' you mentioned... who is she?' Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, then shook his head: 'When the time comes, you'll know.' His form gradually faded. 'Rest well. The true storm is just beginning.'

text.content:
Chen Ji stood before the window, watching the morning sun gradually rise.

The Tianji Record pulsed again: golden text materialized before his eyes—'First stage objective completed: Tianji Record three pages united. Next volume's pivotal turn: Ling Yuan's true identity will be revealed in Volume 2, Chapter 35.'

Chen Ji stared at these words, a cold smile playing at the corner of his lips. Ling Yuan, that seemingly protective old sect master secretly harboring malicious intentions. Finally, his true face would be exposed?

'Excellent.' he murmured. 'Come then, let the tempest rage even more猛烈些.' He turned and walked toward his bed. In the coming days, he would spare no effort preparing, ready to face the even greater challenges ahead.

Twenty-six days remained until Chen Nian's sacrifice.

Seven days until the Heavenly Eye's second trial.

And he, Chen Ji, had formally entered the game. The chessboard was set, the pieces positioned. Now, the question: who would laugh last?
